create_filter_instance: create a Filter instance with a MuJoCo MjModel to interface with the MuJoCo MPC filter server
run_filter_init: run the Filter init method to initialize the filter with a MuJoCo model sent as XML or MJB
run_filter_state: run the Filter state method to retrieve estimated state, time, and force arrays from the filter
run_filter_covariance: run the Filter covariance method to retrieve the filter's covariance matrix as a 2D numpy array
run_filter_noise: run the Filter noise method to retrieve process and sensor noise arrays from the filter
